title: Australia says it could follow Canada in forging deeper ties with EU

paragraphs.en: Trade minister says Canberra is on the same page as Ottawa and ‘will take great interest in what Mark Carney does’
paragraphs.zh: 贸易部长表示，堪培拉与渥太华立场一致，并“将密切关注马克·卡尼的举动”

paragraphs.en: Australia is aligned with Canada’s efforts to seek closer ties with the EU as Ottawa faces an escalating trade dispute with the US.
paragraphs.zh: 澳大利亚与加拿大寻求与欧盟建立更紧密关系的努力保持一致，目前渥太华正面临与美国的贸易争端不断升级。

paragraphs.en: After the Wall Street Journal reported that Canada was exploring “associate member” status of the EU, prime minister Mark Carney clarified on Sunday that his nation was seeking a “unique alliance” with the bloc rather than full membership.
paragraphs.zh: 在《华尔街日报》报道加拿大正在探索成为欧盟“准成员”的可能性后，总理马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）周日澄清称，加拿大寻求的是与该集团建立一种“独特的联盟”关系，而非正式成员资格。

paragraphs.en: “We are on the same page," Australian trade minister Don Farrell told the Sydney Morning Herald on Tuesday. "We will take great interest in what Carney does."
paragraphs.zh: 澳大利亚贸易部长唐·法瑞尔周二对《悉尼先驱晨报》表示：“我们意见一致。” “我们将密切关注卡尼的举动。”

sents.en: “We are on the same page," Australian trade minister Don Farrell told the Sydney Morning Herald on Tuesday.
sents.zh: 澳大利亚贸易部长唐·法瑞尔周二对《悉尼先驱晨报》表示：“我们意见一致。”

sents.en: "We will take great interest in what Carney does."
sents.zh: “我们将密切关注卡尼的举动。”

paragraphs.en: Mr Farrell did not elaborate on whether Australia was actively pursuing a deeper relationship with the EU, or what form that could take.
paragraphs.zh: 法雷尔先生没有详细说明澳大利亚是否正在积极寻求与欧盟建立更深层次的关系，以及这种关系可能采取何种形式。

paragraphs.en: Australia has sought to diversify its trade after facing US tariffs on exports, despite its long-standing security pact and free trade deal with Washington.
paragraphs.zh: 在出口商品面临美国关税之后，尽管与华盛顿签有长期安全条约和自由贸易协定，澳大利亚仍寻求实现贸易多元化。

paragraphs.en: A spokesperson for the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade did not respond to a comment request.
paragraphs.zh: 外交部与贸易部的一位发言人未回应置评请求。

paragraphs.en: Canada and the EU are discussing allowing Canadian goods, services and workers in key sectors – AI, energy, defence, and critical minerals – to move freely, effectively shifting the EU border, according to the Journal . Talks encompass shared infrastructure projects such as underwater cables, data centres, cloud storage, satellite networks, and energy transport facilities.
paragraphs.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，加拿大和欧盟正在讨论允许加拿大关键领域——人工智能、能源、国防和关键矿产——的商品、服务和劳动者自由流动，实际上相当于把欧盟边境进行了转移。 谈判涵盖共享基础设施项目，例如海底电缆、数据中心、云存储、卫星网络和能源运输设施。

sents.en: Canada and the EU are discussing allowing Canadian goods, services and workers in key sectors – AI, energy, defence, and critical minerals – to move freely, effectively shifting the EU border, according to the Journal .
sents.zh: 据《华尔街日报》报道，加拿大和欧盟正在讨论允许加拿大关键领域——人工智能、能源、国防和关键矿产——的商品、服务和劳动者自由流动，实际上相当于把欧盟边境进行了转移。

sents.en: Talks encompass shared infrastructure projects such as underwater cables, data centres, cloud storage, satellite networks, and energy transport facilities.
sents.zh: 谈判涵盖共享基础设施项目，例如海底电缆、数据中心、云存储、卫星网络和能源运输设施。

paragraphs.en: Mr Carney has spoken regularly with EU leaders, most notably French president Emmanuel Macron, about allowing Canadians to live and work visa-free in the EU, the paper reported, citing two unnamed officials.
paragraphs.zh: 据该报援引两名不愿透露姓名的官员的说法，卡尼先生与欧盟领导人保持定期交流，其中最引人注目的是法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙，双方讨论了允许加拿大人免签证在欧盟生活和工作的事宜。

paragraphs.en: Mr Farrell said he was open to all options in future arrangements with the EU, excluding fibre-optic cables given the distances.
paragraphs.zh: 法雷尔先生表示，他对未来与欧盟的安排持开放态度，愿意考虑所有选项，但由于距离原因，排除了光纤电缆。

paragraphs.en: "The world is dividing into protectionists and free traders," he said. "It's indisputable that Australian prosperity of the last 50 years has all been about our engagement with the world."
paragraphs.zh: 「世界正在分裂成保护主义者和自由贸易者，」他说。 「无可争辩的是，澳大利亚过去50年的繁荣完全源于我们与世界的交往。」

sents.en: "The world is dividing into protectionists and free traders," he said.
sents.zh: 「世界正在分裂成保护主义者和自由贸易者，」他说。

sents.en: "It's indisputable that Australian prosperity of the last 50 years has all been about our engagement with the world."
sents.zh: 「无可争辩的是，澳大利亚过去50年的繁荣完全源于我们与世界的交往。」

paragraphs.en: Australia and the EU signed a free trade agreement in March after eight years of talks, removing tariffs on almost all goods and potentially easing EU access to Australian critical minerals.
paragraphs.zh: 澳大利亚与欧盟经过八年谈判后于今年3月签署了自由贸易协定，取消了几乎所有商品的关税，并可能为欧盟获取澳大利亚关键矿产提供便利。
